question:
From the data in the IZA Global Preferences Survey, which countries met at least two of the following criteria:
Countries that scored less than -.4 in Patience
Countries that scored more than .4 in Risk taking
Countries that scored less than -.4 in Altruism
Countries that scored more than .4 in negative Reciprocity
Countries that scored less than -.4 in Trust
gold_answer:
Cameroon (Patience, Trust)
Czech Republic (Trust, Altruism)
Zimbabwe (Trust, Risk Taking)
Hungary (Patience, Altruism)
Saudi Arabia (Risk Taking, Negative Reciprocity)
Tanzania (Risk Taking, Altruism)
Malawi (Trust, Risk Taking)
